title: Form Energy header
description: A transparent header laid over a dark hero: a white stacked wordmark at the left and a row of uppercase Roboto Mono links with small solid carets at the right, each turning orange on hover over 0.4s and dropping a black submenu panel. On phones a hamburger opens the whole menu in a black panel under the bar.
notes: a .dark scope: white text and a black menu panel under any theme
overlay (default) sits absolutely at the top of its positioned parent and scrolls away with the page; overlay={false} renders it as a black bar in the flow
dropdowns open on hover and keyboard focus (CSS); the phone menu is a <details> toggle, so no JavaScript
